criteria.evidence: MET at head. The prior report .scratch/code-release-10-10-v2/reports/27-audit.md marked this 'partially met' on the claim that '2 cron operations are unregistered' and that `check:contract-registry` exits 1 with GET/POST /cron/calendar-provider-sync-sweep absent from the registry (finding T27-F5, summary row PRD-C022). That is untrue at head: /tmp/beg-check_contract-registry.log ends 'OK - all 3662 operations are classified', exit 0. All three clauses hold. (a) Nest module registration: /tmp/beg-check_module-registration.log - '218 module class(es) declared, 217 reachable from AppModule, 0 unreachable', exit 0. (b) One canonical frontend route owner: `find app -name page.tsx | wc -l` = 600; stripping route groups and parallel segments yields 600 distinct URLs and `uniq -d` returns nothing (0 duplicates); `npm run check:routes` exit 0, '655 route directories walked'. (c) No preserved hidden duplicates: /tmp/beg-check_route-duplicates.log exit 0 - 'operationId duplicates: 0, genuinely ambiguous param-vs-param routes: 0'. Its 2 'version inconsistency' notes are not duplicates - openapi.json shows /users -> UsersController_listUsers and /v2/users -> UsersController_listUsersV2_v2, distinct operations, i.e. deliberate versioning.

The compatibility-path clause fails outright. 7 `@deprecated` sites survive in 4 backend files and NONE carries a removal date, a named consumer or a contract test: src/common/region/region.config.ts:68 ('Kept for backward compat'), src/modules/hr/recruitment/dto/candidates.schemas.ts:27,29, src/modules/hr/interviews/dto/hr-interviews.schemas.ts:18,20 (both '@deprecated prefer page/pageSize'), src/modules/cron/cron-hr-retention.service.ts:47,49 ('Compatibility fields'). The duplicated-constants clause also fails - see PRD-C032. Additional dead surface the contraction did not reach: /tmp/beg-check_outbox-consumers.log lists 29 declared/registered event types against 24 emitted, so expense.submitted, expense.decided, accounting.invoice.reminder.due, kb.content.delete and integration.connection.disconnected are registered consumers for events nothing emits. REFUTED sub-claim: the prior report's '66 production TODOs' is false at head - a comment-anchored grep over app/components/features/hooks/lib/types finds 0 TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX comments in the frontend and 1 in the backend (src/modules/hr/cases/service-delivery-inbox.service.ts:174, which documents the ticket_status enum values). The raw string 'TODO' is a ticket-status enum member in this codebase, which is what inflates a naive count. Debug logging is genuinely clean: 0 console.log/debug/dir in frontend app source and 0 in backend src outside scripts/specs.
criteria.blocker: 7 @deprecated compatibility paths retained with no removal date, no named consumer and no contract test - the criterion's explicit retention condition. Closing it needs each of the 4 files either contracted away or given the three-part retention record.

criteria.evidence: Three duplicated constants survive at head, all with two or more real callers. (1) `formatFileSize` defined 3x with divergent behaviour: lib/format-utils.ts:31 (1-decimal KB, GB tier), features/hr/documents/document-table-constants.ts:109 (accepts null, returns em-dash, 0-decimal KB, caps at MB), features/chat/chat-helpers.ts:80 which is a bare pass-through wrapper `return _formatFileSize(bytes);` - exactly the shape the criterion says to apply the deletion test to. (2) `DataScope` declared 3x in the frontend (hooks/api/roles-schema.ts:69, hooks/api/access-schema.ts:65, hooks/api/module-access/types.ts:5) against exactly one canonical domain owner in the backend, src/common/rbac/data-scope.ts:1. (3) `ApprovalStatus` declared 5x with two incompatible value sets: types/accounting/taxes.ts:132, types/payroll/payout.ts:1 and features/accounting/shared/finance-status.tsx:34 all 'PENDING'|'APPROVED'|'REJECTED'; types/projects/approvals.ts:11; hooks/api/workflows-types.ts:6 'pending'|'approved'|'rejected'|'delegated'|'expired'.

Closing it needs formatFileSize collapsed to one owner, DataScope reduced to the single backend-owned contract, and ApprovalStatus split into the two genuinely different domain unions with one owner each.
criteria.clauses_failing: replace duplicated/weakly owned constants with the canonical domain-owned schema; apply the deletion test to pass-through wrappers

criteria.evidence: Two of the criterion's named proof dimensions have no sound mechanism. (1) The import/dependency graph itself is contaminated on the backend. src/scripts/check-dead-code.mjs:147 `walkSource` filters only OUT_OF_SCOPE_SEGMENTS = {node_modules, dist, coverage, .git, migrations, .scratch, .scan, graphify-out} (:77-79) - `.claude` is absent, and the repo holds 8336 .ts files under .claude/worktrees/ (2 worktrees). The gate's own summary shows the result: 'importer graph: 9932 files, 69914 edges' against 5904 real .ts files in src/+test/, so ~4028 graph files (40.6%) are worktree duplicates. It produced a demonstrable FALSE RETAIN: the RETAINED-BY-CONTRACT line for src/modules/ai/core/dto/request.schemas.ts:MeetingPrepInput cites 'a live boundary in .claude/worktrees/bold-napier-7a4a41/src/modules/ai/core/controllers/crm-ai.controller.ts', while `grep -rn meetingPrepSchema src/` returns only the declaration site src/modules/ai/core/dto/request.schemas.ts:64,71 - nothing in shipped source parses with it. The frontend twin does not have this defect: scripts/check-repo-paths.mjs:101-103 `isExcludedScanDir` returns true for any name starting with '.'. SCAN_FLOOR only guards under-scanning, so nothing catches this. (2) Cron registration: openapi.json declares 68 /cron/* paths (of 2703), `grep -rn '@Cron(' src` finds 1, no schedule/cron/jobs manifest exists in either repo, and none of the 7 .github/workflows files invokes a /cron/ route - so no cron endpoint's removal can be proven safe from the repository.
criteria.blocker: The dependency-graph dimension is unsound (backend importer map walks .claude/worktrees, already emitting one proven false retain) and the cron-registration dimension has no mechanism at all. Closing it needs `.claude` added to OUT_OF_SCOPE_SEGMENTS (or the frontend's dot-dir rule adopted), the MeetingPrepInput verdict re-derived against src/ only, and a committed schedule manifest that a gate diffs against the /cron/* route set.
